intro.title: LemonDouble
intro.body:
I love building fun things.
From servers and smart homes to AI, web services, hardware and games, here's what I've been making.

homelab.title: A tiny datacenter at home
homelab.body:
I run a Kubernetes cluster on mini PCs and a GPU workstation.
The services I build and everyday ones like photo backups and a social network all run on it.

smarthome.title: Running my home with code
smarthome.body:
Every device in my home is connected and managed through Home Assistant.
When a device or service has no official integration, I write one myself.

mlai.title: From models to services
mlai.body:
I refine models myself, like speech synthesis and manga translation, and turn them into services I actually use.
These days I also spend a lot of time working alongside AI agents.

web.title: One login for everything
web.body:
When I need a web service, I build it myself.
It's a hobby server, but it supports TOTP and Passkeys, and one login gets you into everything from a manga translator to a quote search.

hardware.title: Things you can touch and move
hardware.body:
Beyond software on a screen, I also build things you can hold and that actually move.
I design the circuits and PCBs, make the cases with CAD and a 3D printer, and have built a wireless macropad and a weapon from a game.

game.title: Making my own game
game.body:
I'm building a bullet-hell action roguelite in Godot.
From the world and characters to the maps, I'm filling it in piece by piece.

contact.title:
Have a question?
Feel free to reach out
contact.body: You can find all my projects and the tools I use on my blog via '{projects}' in the top right. If you have any questions, reach me on any channel below.

projects.lemon-k8s-cluster: A K3S homelab cluster on a mini PC and a GPU workstation
projects.misskey: A microblogging social network instance I run myself
projects.kepco-powerplanner-ha-addon: An add-on that brings KEPCO PowerPlanner electricity usage into Home Assistant
projects.hass-kakao-map-changer: An integration that swaps the Home Assistant map for Kakao Map
projects.lemon-tts: A Home Assistant integration that speaks Japanese from any input language
projects.hayakoe: A Japanese TTS library polished to be easy to use
projects.lemon-manga-translator: A pipeline that finds text in Japanese manga, translates it into Korean and redraws it
projects.claude-dashboard: A web dashboard that shows Claude Code usage at a glance
projects.geardrak: A 16-key wireless macropad I built myself, from circuit to case
projects.supernova: A 3D-printed display prop of Aris's Supernova from Blue Archive
